_what: Names, sizes and starting values of a brand-new account at a computer (src/account/create.rs). The restore receipt is written last, so its existence makes a state folder an account. The object index names the account control's policy database and the account's own records store (`records_file`, a record store made empty and ready at its first generation `records_generation`; the opener finds it by the name `records_name_prefix` + [owner id, the browser resource]). The app key-value database carries the account key's identity rows, as the Mac enrollment writes them. The user id and owner id are random; the account's address comes from its own signing key (src/account/computers.rs). No id carries a computer name. A new account starts as canonical born policy; create.rs binds account_controls.owner_user_id to its freshly made user before the restore receipt publishes it.
